note: From the OpenStreetMap export (OSM's main API, 13 October 2026; tools/osm-to-kit.mjs) and the views from above (docs/reference/aerial/marple.jpg and marple-wide.jpg), at real scale across the line like the tracks: two side platforms on the Marple line in a wooded cutting, platform 1 (the halt's, towards Manchester) on the west side, about 147 m long (u -78 to 69), and platform 2 on the east, about 134 m (u -56 to 78), each 1.68 m outside its track; the footbridge crosses mid-station at u 1.5; the booking office stands behind platform 2 just south of it, and the station car park (Marple Station Car Park) lies east of the line at platform level, between the booking office and Brabyns Brow (A626), which crosses the line on a bridge at the south end (u -104 to -92); a footpath and cycle bridge from Brabyns Park crosses at the north end (u 131 to 140). Trains stop 20 m north of the station's point, so a two-car unit stands on the platforms as they are and a six-car one once both are extended north. Positive v is east. Photos (docs/reference/photos/marple: overview-1.jpg Gerald England 2025, overview-2.jpg philandju 2017, footbridge-1.jpg and footbridge-2.jpg Chris Morgan 2021 and 2015, platform-from-footbridge-1.jpg and platform-north-1.jpg England 2017, platform-2-north-2.jpg and building-1.jpg El Pollock 2015): the footbridge is enclosed in blue steel panels, with stairs down to each platform and a stone-faced lift tower at each end (the lifts); the booking office is a low flat-roofed brick building with a blue band under its eaves; red timber fences line the platforms' backs; the road bridge is stone on a segmental arch, drawn as one arch over both tracks, and the north bridge a stone arch too (platform-2-north-2.jpg; the canal tunnel beyond it isn't drawn). The photos' index puts the road bridge at the north end; the export and the views from above put Brabyns Brow at the south end, and this kit follows them. Each platform has a Northern-blue shelter by the footbridge; there is no canopy in any photo, so the canopy is the game's. Bus stops A and B ('Brabyns Brow / Marple Station') are the export's: the bus link stands at Stop B on Brabyns Brow by the car park entrance, and the rail replacement buses on the forecourt by the booking office (from memory, placed by eye). The car park is the export's outline split in two (the first stage nearest the booking office, the second its far end), drawn as rectangles; the cycle stands are the export's (on platform 2's wide end; drawn behind it). No taxi rank in the photos or the export, so none. Lamps and departure boards placed by eye; the shop is the game's. Across the line at real scale since 13 October 2026 (it was 1.25 times).
